_description: Guardian-band validation matrix (docs/spec.md 'The [min_shares, max_shares] band'): MinThreshold ≤ threshold ≤ min_shares ≤ max_shares ≤ 32 and max_shares − min_shares < threshold (strict). The chain (x/secrets/types.ValidateShareBand) and every client assert this matrix in CI so the rule cannot drift between implementations. Append-only, like every corpus in this directory: new vectors may be added, existing vectors are never edited or removed. 'reason' on invalid rows is informational — implementations match the verdict, not the text.

valid.name: min at threshold, widest legal gap
narrow band forced by low threshold
default client preset shape (30% clamped by gap)

invalid.name: min below threshold
invalid.reason: min_shares < threshold: a min-sized activation could not reach threshold reveals

invalid.name: gap equal to threshold (boundary reject)
invalid.reason: max − min must be strictly below threshold

invalid.name: gap above threshold
invalid.reason: max − min must be strictly below threshold

invalid.name: gap equal to low threshold (boundary reject)
invalid.reason: max − min must be strictly below threshold
